description: Search recent posts, read profiles, and fetch a post or timeline from X.
limitations: Recent search is last 7 days. Posting is not offered. Not LinkedIn, not a firehose.
setup_hint: Connect with an X API bearer token.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Recent posts from the last 7 days. Pass a search query; operators such as from:user work.

tools.name: user
tools.description: One X profile. Pass a username (@optional) or user id.

tools.name: posts
tools.description: Recent posts from one account. Pass a username or user id.

tools.name: post
tools.description: One post. Pass a post id or an x.com / twitter.com status URL.
